name: @ran-sh/dsh-vision
description: Provider-neutral vision service interface for the DeepSeek Harness: owns ctx.vision (VisionRuntime), the VisionAdapter contract, and provider registration/directory/discovery primitives. Provider plugins (e.g. dsh-plugin-image-mind) inject ['vision'] and register into it — the same Service Definition / Provider Plugin split as @deepseek-ai/dsh-llm vs @deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-deepseek.
